description: First real-media collection: four GIPHY GIFs (two transparent stickers, two opaque squares), two portrait 1080x1920 H.264 renders, and one static display font. Used to prove the asset pipeline.

Animation Cartoon Sticker by FUN WITH FR.description: Hand-drawn magenta retro computer with a melting yellow smiley on a green screen, on a transparent ground. Only two frames (a boil), 0.2 s each; portrait 390x480.

filmstrip.file: filmstrips/Animation Cartoon Sticker by FUN WITH FRIDAY.gif.jpg

Art Animation GIF by Mr Tronch.gif.description: Psychedelic rainbow bust with a hat, two bulging eyeballs and a heart on its chest, over black with a glowing floor. Colours cycle through the figure and return; it loops. Drawn on threes: every third step is a held frame. Stored delays alternate 7 and 6 hundredths (about 15 fps).

filmstrip.file: filmstrips/Art Animation GIF by Mr Tronch.gif.jpg

Cartoon Glitch GIF by Santi_OFF.gif.description: 3D cartoon characters (yellow figure, red-capped figure with glasses making a peace sign) with VHS glitch bars and a timestamp. Opens on colour bars and ends on static, with hard cuts inside, so it does not loop.

Fun Love Sticker by Tarver.gif.description: Round blue smiley face with pink cheeks and a wide grin, wobbling in place on a transparent ground. Loops on its own; fills its square frame.

movie-2026-10-19-19-57.0.mp4.description: Crowd of identical 3D cartoon figures in pink and white jackets dancing on black; the crowd thins to a handful and fills again. 60 fps, 30 s, portrait. Black ground suits screen or lighten blending. Not a loop.

slapchop-video-20260824-205001-10s.mp4.description: Fast kaleidoscopic collage tunnel: mirrored wedges of flat cyan, magenta, yellow and blue with photo cut-outs (moon, lips, eye, splashes) rushing through a central vanishing point. Changes completely every second or two; no loop.

BBH Bogle.description: Heavy condensed sans-serif display face with tight spacing and squared counters; one static weight (Regular). Covers all printable ASCII. Reads well as a single loud word with an outline over busy video.
